items.title: Kering H1 2026 results: group returns to growth, Gucci still declining but margin improves
items.summary: Kering reported H1 2026 revenue of 7,220 million euros (+1% comparable), with recurring operating margin up 40bps to 12.8% and net debt cut to 3.3 billion euros. Gucci posted H1 revenue of 2,757 million euros, down 5% comparably, though Q2 directly-operated retail decline narrowed to 2% (a 7-point sequential improvement from Q1), helped by the Borsetto and Paparazzo launches; Western Europe and Asia-Pacific showed early recovery signs while mainland China stayed challenging.

items.title: French trade analysis: Kering's Q2 growth owes more to portfolio diversification than a real Gucci turnaround
items.summary: This French luxury-trade analysis argues Kering's celebrated return to growth is not primarily a Gucci story: the piece states plainly that Gucci has not yet regained fully positive momentum, and credits the real progress to diversification into jewelry (Boucheron), eyewear and Saint Laurent rather than to fixing Gucci. It flags China weakness, geopolitical risk and unproven results under Demna as still-open risks, concluding the quarter earned Kering credibility, not completion.

items.title: FashionNetwork France assesses whether Gucci is really beginning its turnaround
items.summary: French trade outlet FashionNetwork examines Gucci's Q2 improvement in the context of Kering's broader H1 results, noting the Primavera collection reached stores from mid-July with a bigger marketing push planned for late August intended to lift Q4 sales; the piece frames Gucci's China weakness and inflation-hit middle-class demand as the key headwinds still standing between the brand and a confirmed recovery.

items.title: Reuters-wire coverage: Gucci margin improvement helps rebuild Kering investor confidence
items.summary: Wire coverage of Kering's H1 results emphasizes margin discipline at Gucci as the more durable signal than the top-line beat, citing sequential improvement in directly operated retail and continued cost control under CEO Luca de Meo as reasons analysts are cautiously rebuilding confidence in the turnaround thesis.

items.title: Belgian trade press: Kering's relief is real but Gucci's recovery remains fragile
items.summary: RetailDetail EU's headline framing captures the ambivalence in European trade coverage: Kering's Q2 revenue rose 2% like-for-like to 3.65 billion euros and shares jumped, but the outlet stresses the improvement is fragile, pointing to a prior quarter (Q3-equivalent period) where Gucci sales fell 14% as a reminder that swings can reverse quickly.

items.title: Cagliari police seize 15,000+ fake jewelry pieces and 700 counterfeit garments faking Gucci and other brands
items.summary: Italy's Guardia di Finanza in Cagliari confiscated over 15,000 unsafe counterfeit jewelry items and roughly 700 counterfeit clothing pieces and accessories imitating Gucci, Armani, Saint Laurent, Tommy Hilfiger and Nike; three people face consumer-code and trafficking referrals as investigators trace the supply chain into Sardinia.

items.title: ANSA wire: financial police seize counterfeit Gucci and luxury accessories destined for Ligurian beach vendors
items.summary: National wire agency ANSA reports Italy's financial police intercepted counterfeit bags, belts and accessories bearing Gucci and other luxury-brand markings, complete with fake authenticity certificates, that were headed for informal beach-vendor sales along the Liguria coast, part of a broader seasonal enforcement push against counterfeit luxury goods.

items.title: Trustpilot reviews continue to flag Gucci product-quality and customer-service complaints
items.summary: Recent customer reviews on Gucci's Trustpilot page describe recurring quality and service complaints: items reportedly failing after light use (one reviewer cited 170-euro socks developing a hole after one wash), unhelpful responses on repairs versus exchanges, and unresolved order or shipping issues; these consumer-generated complaints continue to accumulate alongside the brand's official European retail channels.
